strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-beta large/mid-cap stocks and broad sector ETFs. Rides relative strength with trailing stops; cuts losers fast. Aggressive sizing inside hard guardrails — paper only. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no sub-$10.
rules: Enter on a breakout above a 20-day base with above-average volume and positive relative strength.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity per name.
18% trailing stop on every entry; tighten to 12% once +15% in profit.
Take partial profit at +8–12%; let the remainder trail.
No new entries if the daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; flatten and stop for the month at −25%.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16-24): trim sizes 25%, be choosier on entries.
